lede: Personal memory, selfhood, lived experience and unspoken narratives: the Open to All exhibition at La Galerie, Alliance Française de Dhaka, ran 1–9 September 2026.
body:
For anyone searching for an **art exhibition in Dhaka** in early September 2026, B-POP Tags flagged one with an open door: the Open to All Art Exhibition at La Galerie, Alliance Française de Dhaka. It was presented by [@afdhaka](https://www.instagram.com/afdhaka/) and curated by [@zeba_dhaka](https://www.instagram.com/zeba_dhaka/).

## About the Open to All art exhibition in Dhaka

Our caption described the show as a varied collection of pieces investigating the deep connections between "personal recollection, selfhood, lived experience, and unspoken narratives." That's a broad brief, and a generous one. It invites work about the private stories people carry but rarely say out loud.

The invitation card on our cover carries the title না বলা কথা (*Na Bola Kotha*), with "Untold Story" printed in English beneath it, a fitting name for a show about the unspoken. The photo is credited via Lilac Amour on Instagram.

## Dates, venue and opening hours

- **Dates:** 1–9 September 2026
- **Venue:** La Galerie, Alliance Française de Dhaka, 26 Mirpur Road, Dhanmondi, Dhaka
- **Hours:** open daily, 3:00–9:00 PM

The exhibition has now closed. If you went, tell us what stayed with you in the comments on the original post.

## Why shows like this matter

Galleries can feel closed off. A show that announces itself as open to all and builds its theme around ordinary memory lowers that barrier. Visitors don't need a background in art to recognise a story about who they are or what went unsaid at home.

Exhibitions like this are a big part of our [art and fashion coverage](topic:art). For an artist working with similar questions of identity and belonging, read our profile of [Hridita Anisha](post:hridita-anisha-artist-profile). For a very different kind of art experience, see [Embryonic Shifts, a stroboscopic art installation](post:embryonic-shifts-stroboscopic-art-installation), and for what else happened that week, the [9 September roundup](post:dhaka-scene-roundup-9-september-2026). There's more on the [B-POP Tags home page](home:).

[See the original post on Instagram](https://www.instagram.com/p/Dc6ZfJAGjtA/)
